blocks.h2: What a Lincoln Park Plumbing Inspection Covers

steps.body: Age, venting, relief valve and drain pan.
Valves that close and lines that aren't worn.
Slow drains and signs of trouble.

blocks.h2: Why Maintenance Matters in Lincoln Park
blocks.intro: About 1 in 3 homes here was built before 1940.

items.body: A leak upstairs is a ceiling stain downstairs.
Renovated kitchens often sit on original plumbing.
Know what's coming before it fails.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: A building checkup looks at the shared systems: the main water line, the sewer lateral, stacks, the gas service and any shared water heaters or pumps. Each unit's own fixtures are a separate visit. Boards get a written summary of what's in good shape, what's wearing out and what to budget for. That makes reserve planning easier and cuts down on emergency calls.
Each unit or building gets a written summary of what's fine, what to watch and what needs attention, with flat prices for any recommended work. Boards can use it for reserve planning.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should I have a plumbing checkup?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rhythm, especially in an older building.

items.q: Can you inspect a whole two-flat?
items.answer: Yes. We check both units and the shared systems.

items.q: Does the No Drip Club include checkups?
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits.

items.q: Can you inspect before I buy?
items.answer: Yes. Paired with a [sewer camera inspection](/chicago-lincoln-park/video-camera-sewer-inspections), it gives you a clear picture.

items.q: How often should a condo building get a checkup?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rhythm.

items.q: Can you check the water heaters in every unit?
items.answer: Yes, during a building checkup or one unit at a time.

items.q: How much does plumbing maintenance cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the visit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's included. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
